corrections.text: The Overview section quotes the blog post as saying the featured-enhancements list "is not a commitment." with a terminal period. In the source, those words are not a standalone sentence: the full sentence reads "This is not a commitment and the release content is subject to change." (the article itself quotes this complete sentence correctly later, in its "What We Don't Know" section). The earlier instance should be read as a partial quotation, not a complete one.
